content: The latest MCP cancellation specification (2025-11-25) defines notifications/cancelled as an optional notification carrying requestId and optional reason. It must reference a previously issued, believed-in-progress request in the same direction; initialize must not be cancelled. Receivers should stop work, free resources, and not send a response, may ignore unknown/already-completed/malformed IDs, and both sides must tolerate races where cancellation arrives after completion. Implementations should log cancellation reasons. A long-running stdio tool must therefore treat host process exit/EOF, cancellation, and response-after-cancel as separate lifecycle states rather than assuming a single timeout.
